question_text: What synthetic gene circuits have been built and characterised, and how does their designed logic compare to natural circuits?
cutoff_rationale: Sampled actual titles at 2-point percentile intervals from 40th-58th percentile. On-topic synthetic-circuit content held through ~48th percentile (score ~0.36); by 52nd-58th percentile the mix was dominated by unrelated material (melanoma classifiers, implantable neural stimulators, phenotypic heterogeneity/evolution). Cutoff set at the boundary where the qualitative mix shifts, not a round number chosen in advance.
